title: Australian Grain Technologies Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of InterGrain Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties. ACCC assessing information provided during market inquiries and consulting with merger parties on any relevant issues or concerns arising.
ACCC requested further information from the parties. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (9 March 2017) delayed to allow the parties time to provide the additional information.
ACCC waiting on information from vendor. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (30 March 2017) delayed.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Timeline suspended pending provision of information from the parties.
Review suspended following public announcement by the WAAA and GRDC re the cessation of negotiations in relation to the proposed acquisition. Review may recommence at a later date.
Review discontinued. A new review will be commenced if negotiations in relation to the proposed acquisition are recommenced.
